description: YouTube API: Get a transcript. The transcript of a video as timed segments and plain text. Without `lang` you get the video's default caption track. format=vtt puts a WebVTT subtitle file in `text`; format=chunks returns `chunks` (index, text, start, end in seconds) with the chunk_size and chunk_overlap used: whole segments merged into pieces of about chunk_size characters, ready for embeddings. Price: 1 credit per call; failed calls are free.

chunk_overlap.description: `format=chunks` only: characters of whole segments repeated from the end of the previous chunk (less than `chunk_size`)

chunk_size.description: `format=chunks` only: target characters per chunk (segments are never split)

format.description: `json` (segments + text), `text` or `srt`. `vtt` (WebVTT subtitles in `text`) or `chunks` (timestamped chunks for embeddings, in `chunks`).

lang.description: Language code (e.g. `en`, `it`, `pt-BR`); auto-translated when the video doesn't have it

name: youtube_transcript
title: Get a transcript
